definitions.explanation: A densely populated urban area with modern infrastructure, entertainment, and commercial activity. Contrasts with {田舎|いなか} (countryside, rural area).

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦だけど→だけど：00033_dakedo⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: City life is convenient but busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{都会|とかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しました→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved from the countryside to the city.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: In the city, trains are more convenient than cars.

notes:
Refers to large urban centers characterized by tall buildings, public transportation, shops, and dense population. Often contrasted with ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧ (countryside).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都会|とかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (city life)
- {都会|とかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (live in the city)
- {都会|とかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (go to the city)
- {都会|とかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (work in the city)

SCOPE NOTE:
{都会|とかい} refers to any large city, while ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ is more formal/technical for 'city' and ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧ specifically means 'capital city.'
